proposed_comments.title: Preserve cleared optional property values
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve cleared optional property values

**Severity:** `high`

When an extension clears an optional observable property by assigning `undefined`, `JSON.stringify` omits that property from `command/propChanged`. The native adapter therefore never sees the clear and can retain stale title, subtitle, icon, or nested-command state. Please serialize changed `undefined` values as JSON `null` and add a wire-level regression test for clearing a property.

confidence.rationale: The notification payload directly embeds the reflected value, and JSON serialization omits object properties whose value is undefined.

proposed_comments.title: Route property changes to the intended adapter
proposed_comments.body:
### Route property changes to the intended adapter

**Severity:** `high`

The registry dispatches each payload to every target registered under the same command ID. A command item and its nested command can share that ID while legitimately exposing different title or icon values, so an item update can overwrite command state and raise unrelated notifications. Please carry a target-kind discriminator in the SDK notification and filter dispatch by that discriminator, while retaining legacy fan-out for older senders that omit it.

confidence.rationale: The loop unconditionally applies the same properties object to every live target for the command ID, and item/command adapters share IDs.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize status operations and startup replay
proposed_comments.body:
### Serialize status operations and startup replay

**Severity:** `medium`

`ShowStatus` and `HideStatus` are asynchronous, but this code starts them without preserving request order or waiting during disposal. A delayed show can complete after a hide or provider disposal, leaving stale status UI visible; initialization can similarly run a new notification before older buffered notifications finish replaying. Please queue status operations through disposal and drain the startup buffer before switching to inline dispatch.

confidence.rationale: The async actions are intentionally discarded, so completion can reorder independently of the locked bookkeeping and disposal path.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve Adaptive Card action identifiers
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve Adaptive Card action identifiers

**Severity:** `high`

This proxy implements only `IFormContent`, so the host cannot call the action-aware `IFormContent2.SubmitAction` path. The selected Adaptive Card action ID is discarded, making multiple submit actions in one JavaScript form indistinguishable. Please implement `IFormContent2`, forward `actionId` through `form/submit`, and expose an optional action-aware TypeScript handler with backward-compatible fallback to `submitForm`.

confidence.rationale: The proxy contract and request payload contain no action ID, while the host action-aware branch requires IFormContent2.
